steps.name: probe-and-safe-rules
ac: cd apps/web && pnpm exec biome lint --only=a11y/noSvgWithoutTitle --only=a11y/useButtonType --only=a11y/noRedundantRoles src/features/trading src/features/live-sessions src/features/dashboard src/features/waitlist src/features/alert-rules src/features/realtime src/components src/lib src/hooks src/store
cd apps/web && pnpm exec vitest run src/features/trading src/features/live-sessions src/features/dashboard src/features/waitlist src/components src/lib src/hooks
steps.summary: CONTROL: Biome 2.5.9 CLI는 --min-files 옵션을 지원하지 않아 동일 경로 일반 lint로 6건(SVG 4·button 1·table role 1)을 재측정; 장식 SVG 4개 aria-hidden, mock 버튼 type, table role을 수리했고 AC lint·vitest 103파일 813건 통과.

steps.name: template-and-complexity
ac: cd apps/web && pnpm exec biome lint --only=style/useTemplate --only=complexity/noUselessSwitchCase --only=complexity/noUselessFragments --only=complexity/useOptionalChain --only=complexity/useLiteralKeys src/features/trading src/features/live-sessions src/features/dashboard src/features/waitlist src/features/alert-rules src/features/realtime src/components src/lib src/hooks src/store
cd apps/web && pnpm exec vitest run src/features/trading src/features/live-sessions src/features/dashboard src/features/waitlist src/components src/lib src/hooks
steps.summary: trading 주문 UI 4곳과 lib/api-base의 문자열 결합 5건을 템플릿 리터럴로 정리했고, 대상 범위 complexity 4종은 처음부터 0건이었다; order-side 클래스의 끝 공백은 템플릿에서도 보존했다.
